name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.1.86 fixes the Gen1Recomp updater repository to randyadr/Gen2-3D-Sprites. Runtime behavior otherwise matches v0.1.85: in-world 3D battles, weather, camera modes, Johto tree geometry, all-Pokemon 3D fallback, Skin Selector compatibility, and visible START/pause overlays.
